detail.title: Continuing Inquiry: Compositional Expectations in Visual Art
detail.summary: The research continues within the 'visual_art' domain, prioritizing the examination of visual expectation violations in composition. While other projects—specifically those within the 'information_thermodynamics' domain—remain parked due to current topic enforcement, this shift focuses on expanding the empirical foundation for how observers respond to artistic composition and structural constraints.
